verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships with 19 selectable system-wide themes (Style > Theme) and a GUI theme creator (Aether), which plausibly lets a user pick a dark-looking theme, but there is no explicit 'dark mode' toggle or night-light/blue-light-reduction feature documented anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit dark mode setting, night light/blue-light filter feature, or any eye-strain-specific customization option.
